$note: Which human English the reader may show, and which tab opens by default. Read by web/js/app.js (translation tabs) and scripts/build_seo_pages.py (crawler pages). A source not listed here falls back to `unknown`: human hidden, machine shown. show_human=false hides that source's human English even if the API ever returns it. `default` picks the tab a reader sees first when the URL has no &tr=; a reader can still switch to any visible tab. Review status: `reviewed` = licence checked against the source's published terms; `needs_review` = Hayden to decide before human English is shown.

oracc.name: ORACC
oracc.attribution: Translation from the ORACC project edition; credit the project and translator.
oracc.uncertain: Oracc's default licence is CC BY-SA 3.0 'unless otherwise stated'; individual projects can differ, and our per-file JSON metadata says CC0. We use the stricter CC BY-SA 3.0 and show credit + licence.

cdli.name: CDLI
cdli.license: Free reuse with citation (CDLI terms of use)
cdli.attribution: Translation from CDLI (https://cdli.earth); cite CDLI and the P-number.
cdli.uncertain: Not a CC licence: 'may be freely copied, aggregated and re-used according to common and fair academic practice', with a request to cite CDLI. Commercial use of the text is not addressed explicitly.

ebl.name: eBL
ebl.uncertain: Zenodo dataset says MIT but platform terms are unverified; eBL ATF and English must not be displayed or republished. The API already strips eBL human English; this is a second guard.

tlhdig.name: TLHdig
tlhdig.uncertain: Transliterations are CC BY 4.0; no human English from TLHdig is in the corpus today. Hidden until reviewed.

achemenet.name: Achemenet
achemenet.full_name: Linguistically Annotated Achemenet Babylonian Texts (Univ. Helsinki)
achemenet.uncertain: No human English from this source is in the corpus today. Hidden until reviewed.

hayden_pairs.name: Training pairs
hayden_pairs.uncertain: Duplicate of CDLI/ORACC English; excluded from the public export.
